title: Nuclide: a public, cited knowledge graph of radiopharmaceuticals
description: Nuclide maps nuclear medicine as a linked corpus, therapy and diagnostic imaging alike: isotopes, agents, targets, indications, technologies, trials, companies, institutions, people, pathways, pairings, roadmaps, key papers, journals, bottlenecks and ideas, one record per object with a plain-English TL;DR, a technical summary, dated facts and sources. Each release archives the corpus as JSON (per entity and per kind), NDJSON, CSV, a JSON Schema and an OpenAPI description, exactly as published under /api/v1/ of the deployed site. Code is MIT. Data are CC BY-NC 4.0, attribution "Data from Nuclide". Nuclide is a fork of OnCo (https://github.com/judegomila/OnCo), a knowledge graph of oncology; records carried over from OnCo stay under CC BY-NC 4.0 and are attributed to OnCo in the files that hold them. Nothing in the dataset is medical advice.
notes: Facts are being built and checked in the open and may be incomplete, out of date or wrong; verify at the primary source before relying on them. Nothing in this dataset is medical advice.
